notes.title: To the Moon Last Hour Update - Progressing Along!
notes.content: [p]Hey folks, just a quick update to let you know that the project is still going well. d-(' ' d-)[/p][p]Lots of work to set up a foundation in the new engine to build future games with, which has been taking a while, but otherwise progressing along nicely! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731110/b059eed7aa23313844dd3cb1b87ff67753a2b086.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731110/ba61e604bf339a37915774a1d2bac49a101912fe.png"][/img][/p][p]Hoping to wrap up the series nicely with this. Thanks for your patience and being a part of this decade-long journey~[/p]
